notes.title: SAD RPG - Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aoBaY6dQq2k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]
Hello Sad Rabbits![/b][/h3]

[b]Today (11 - 11 - 2021 !) we released “SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game” on Steam Early Access and it’s ready to be played, tested, loved or hated! 
Join us on a surprisingly colorful, weird and full of surprises journey through reality which is a metaphorical fight with social anxiety disorder.
Download the game and let us know what you think - all suggestions, comments, opinions matter for us and are more than welcome - please, share them. You are important :) [/b]

[b]DISCLAIMER: [/b]Be mindful that SAD RPG is still in active development and we will actively work on game updates during the Steam Early Access in 2021/2022.

[h3][b]SAD RPG Steam Early Access features and informations:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] first person perspective
[*] modern day setting
[*] skills development
[*] turn-based anti-anxiety combat
[*] save/load system (in Options menu)
[*] unique graphic
[*] unique soundtrack
[*] story about social anxiety disorder
[*] educational elements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937952/9f81c72f1e2b3644be5509fa5d74a1cdba9bc924.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937952/c31bdec3bf4bbc8d890286e6eff212314816f6e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937952/63cc9fd220e265a7ed16945912d38b4566759e16.png[/img]

[b]SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game[/b] is an experimental indie computer RPG game about social anxiety. 
It's an unexpectedly colourful, weird and full of surprises journey with our own story about dealing with Social Anxiety Disorder.

We are still working on [b]SAD RPG[/b] and plan to provide weekly updates with new content, gameplay improvements and bug fixes. 

We are very curious about your feedback, opinions and overall reception of our game. 
You can contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/uZRQAYU]SAD RPG Discord Server[/url].


[h3]If you like the concept of [b]SAD RPG[/b] or it seems interesting to you, you can play Early Access version on Steam now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/857760/SAD_RPG_A_Social_Anxiety_Role_Playing_Game/

[b]Take care!

Evil Indie Games[/b]

notes.title: SAD RPG Developer Stream
notes.content:
[b]Join us on October 10th, 22:00 CEST / 1:00 PM PST! [/b]

[b]SAD RPG demo[/b] is available on Steam during [b]The Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition 2020[/b]. 

[b]SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game[/b] is an experimental indie computer RPG game about social anxiety. 
It's an unexpectedly colourful, weird and full of surprises journey with our own story about dealing with Social Anxiety Disorder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937952/ccfe916d02453a5882662c5c58bb1d10276bf948.png[/img]

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] Be mindful that SAD RPG is still in development so the provided demo does not fully reflect final version of the game. All things in this demo can change in the development process. 
SAD RPG DEMO contains limited content and story of the game.


[h3]SAD RPG DEMO limitations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] save/load system is disabled in this demo version
[*] demo contains limited portion of content from the beginning of SAD RPG game
[*] demo is based on "work in progress" version of SAD RPG, so everything may change ;)
[/list]


We are still working on SAD RPG and plan to release it in Early Access in the near future. 
We are very curious about your feedback, opinions and overall reception of our game. 
You can contact us on SAD RPG Discord Server.
